ICU Charge Nurse
Harbor Health - Madison, WI

Harbor Health's 30-bed medical ICU is hiring a charge nurse for day shift. The charge nurse runs
the shift: assignments, bedside procedures and the unit's practice changes.

Requirements
- 2+ years of ICU experience as a Registered Nurse
- Experience leading bedside procedures such as central line insertions
- Led a unit-wide practice change or quality project
- Current RN license and ACLS

Preferred
- Precepting or charge nurse experience
- Epic charting

Full-time, 12-hour day shifts. Tuition support and a sign-on bonus.
